what: Remove the daemon's desktop notifier per docs/work/remove-notifier/design.md: notifier.py and its tests, the orchestrator's notifier and new-HIGH tracking, Config's notification fields and the template's [notifications] section (an existing one is ignored with a warning), the verify chain's notify link, and the docs that describe it.
why: The design is docs/work/remove-notifier/design.md (gh #103). The notifier never reached the operator once the daemon ran on a server (57 HIGH batches undelivered, 2026-10-16..22), the macOS menu-bar app now carries the HIGH signal (#102, #105), the exploration decided to remove it outright once the app shipped, and its integration test fails on the macos-latest CI runner.

criteria.given: the daemon package after the change
criteria.when: its sources are imported and a full fetch cycle runs through DaemonOrchestrator.run_once with new HIGH items
criteria.then: no module named prismis_daemon.notifier exists, DaemonOrchestrator takes no notifier argument, the cycle's stats carry no new_high_priority_items key, and no subprocess is started for a notification during the cycle.

criteria.given: a config.toml holding a [notifications] section with high_priority_only and command beside the usual sections, and one without it
criteria.then: both load with every other setting intact; the first logs exactly one WARNING naming [notifications] as ignored and the menu-bar app as its replacement, and the second logs no warning about notifications.

mutations.change: Drop the [notifications] warning so the section is silently ignored; C2 must go red.

criteria.when: the daemon writes its default config.toml
criteria.then: the file has no [notifications] section and loads without the warning.

criteria.given: the verify chain run with --full and without it on the existing recorded-provider fixtures
criteria.then: no link named notify appears in either report, and the deep_extract link is reported with --full and skipped-by-flag without it.

criteria.when: docs/configuration.md, docs/architecture/*.md, README.md and docs/IDEA.md are read
criteria.then: none documents [notifications] or a daemon desktop notification as a current feature, and docs/configuration.md names the macOS menu-bar app for new-HIGH signals.

walks.when: after deploying to the operator's remote host, whose config.toml still has [notifications], the daemon restarts
walks.then: it starts, its log shows the one ignored-section warning, and the next cycle completes with no notification.send events.

outOfScope.summary: A daemon on a Mac without the menu-bar app no longer shows a desktop banner for new HIGH items.

stakes: No daemon code path sends a desktop notification or runs a notification command.
A config.toml with a [notifications] section loads, keeps every other setting, and logs one warning naming the section and its replacement; one without it logs nothing about it.
A new install's config template has no [notifications] section.
The verify chain reports no notify link, and --full still runs and reports deep extraction.
No document describes the daemon notifier as a current feature.
